summary: The page is a careful, largely correct treatment of counterexamples where singular and Cech/sheaf cohomology disagree. The Warsaw circle computations (singular homology of a point via Mayer–Vietoris, nonzero sheaf H^1 via the exponential sequence and the non-liftability of the collapse map) are sound, as are the sine-curve and Cantor-set H^0 computations and the Hawaiian earring H_1 surjection onto the product. The stated-only facts (Hawaiian earring Cech cohomology, fundamental group, Eda–Kawamura map) are correctly flagged as unproved and are consistent with the standard literature. I found no demonstrable mathematical error or non-routine gap worth reporting.
